application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: First-time South African undergraduates apply through CAO (www.cao.ac.za). Medicine closes 30 June 2026 (set per course).

aps_rule.notes: Performance levels 1-8 for six subjects excluding Life Orientation; 90-100% earns 8. Subjects required for the programme must be included. No bonus for extra subjects. Source: applications.ukzn.ac.za undergraduate selection procedure; Study@UKZN brochure.

faculties: College of Agriculture, Engineering and Science

courses.name: Bachelor of Laws (LLB)
courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO codes KN-H-BL1 / KN-P-BL1. Campus: Howard College, Pietermaritzburg. Full-time. School of Law. APS range 48-32 (excl. LO). Alternative route: complete a BA/BSocSc with a law major (or any Bachelor's) and apply with a 60% average and no failed modules, subject to places available. Technical Mathematics not listed. UKZN does not use NBT results.

courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO code KN-H-BLZ. Campus: Howard College. Part-time over 12 semesters. School of Law. APS range 48-32 (excl. LO). Alternative route: complete a BA/BSocSc with a law major (or any Bachelor's) and apply with a 60% average and no failed modules, subject to places available. Technical Mathematics not listed. courses.name: Bachelor of Administration
courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO code KN-W-BAD. Campus: Westville. APS range 48-26 (excl. LO). Early selection: APS 32 with English and LO at Level 4 and Maths Level 3. Specialisations: Human Resource Management, Management, Public Administration. Mathematical Literacy and Technical Mathematics not listed. UKZN does not use NBT results.

courses.name: Bachelor of Business Administration
courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO codes KN-P-BBA / KN-W-BBA. Campus: Pietermaritzburg, Westville. Evening classes only; no funding offered. Three- to four-year qualification (table lists 3 yrs). APS range 48-26 (excl. LO). Applicants not meeting BBA criteria may be considered for the CBA with NSC-Deg, Maths 2 (no Maths Literacy), English and LO 4 and 24 APS. Mathematical Literacy and Technical Mathematics not accepted/listed. UKZN does not use NBT results.

courses.name: Bachelor of Commerce (General)
courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO codes KN-P-BC1 / KN-W-BC1. Campus: Pietermaritzburg, Westville. APS range 48-30 (excl. LO); 'subject to changes'. Early selection: APS 35 with English, LO and Mathematics at Level 5. Specialisations: Economics, Finance, Human Resource Management, Information Systems, Management, Marketing, Supply Chain Management. LO 4 from the p.24 table (not repeated on p.121). Mathematical Literacy and Technical Mathematics not listed. UKZN does not use NBT results.

courses.name: Bachelor of Commerce (General) Extended Curriculum (BCom 4)
courses.faculty: College of Law and Management Studies
courses.notes: CAO codes KN-P-BCG / KN-W-BCG. Campus: Pietermaritzburg, Westville. Three-year BCom extended over four years. APS range 48-26 (excl. LO). For Quintile 1-3 schools (p.124); p.31 says preference given to Quintile 1-3. Not open to anyone who has attended a university/tertiary institution (degree or access programme) for a complete semester. Mathematical Literacy and Technical Mathematics not listed.
